Its confidence score (0.7) is lower than some other unverified findings (e.g., the 16,000 "extremist crimes" claim, confidence 0.85), yet it is the *only* source linked to the 37-pardon claim in the provided data. This could lead to an overreliance on a single, potentially partial report. --- ### **2.
